data.desc:
{#FF5F1F}(**This mod has two versions - 64bit and 32bit version
Clicking on big button on the right downloads 64bit by default, this version will crash if you switched to Legacy branch on Steam
In that case, you need to download 32bit. Click on Downloads tab and download it there
Please note that 32bit version has no auto updates, therefore you need to reinstall EHI to keep receiving updates and fixes if you switch back to 64bit version (Diesel 3.0)
Your settings will be kept intact**)

Do you want to just see codes and other info ? Download **Codes and Info** standalone [here](https://modworkshop.net/mod/59204).

**Please do not run both EHI and standalone versions at the same time.
Mods share the same codebase and game may crash.
Tracking elements in standalone versions is already included in EHI.**

**Minimum game version required: 1.0.0-158409 (Update 247)
Minimum SuperBLT version required: v1.5.0 (Lua) and [4.0.1-beta](https://modworkshop.net/mod/58342) (DLL)
Minimum EHI version to sync data to other EHI players: r427**
**!!! Failing to meet the minimum requirements will cause crashes in-game !!!**

Shows trackers for various heist related gameplay elements
- Waiting for a van/heli/boat
- Waiting for a C4
- Waiting for a thermite to finish
- Achievements*
- Achievements with progress (e.g.: "Another Way Out" achievement in Hell's Island)
- A chance for something to happen (e.g.: teargas, cooking chance)
- Mission XP Overview
- Buffs (skill or perk) and color them based on their action in-game
- Filter achievements tracked in EHI or for **The Secret** -> See progress filter in Achievements Page
- Damage hit markers or Floating health bars
- Hudlist
- etc...

See screenshots in the "Images" tab for more info and how it looks in-game.

EHI is using in-game panels and should be compatible with all HUD mods.
You can change x, y position in options to move it on the screen. The mod supports Ultra-Wide monitors.

**Accuracy**
Always accurate on host.
Clients should stay accurate within 1-3s range. It is recommended to install (on both host and client side players) [Slowmotion Manager](https://modworkshop.net/mod/18128) mod and remove all slowmotion effects that slows down time calculation.
Desync can also disallow some trackers to show up/update. There is nothing to prevent it.
If you drop-in to a heist, some trackers related to elements may not appear. This is because they are not synced when you drop-in. It can be improved, but it is unfixable.

**Trackers**
Some trackers are inaccurate and have orange color. These trackers can prematurely expire or expire late when an element (van, heli, ...) is interactable.

**Supported heists**
All vanilla heists are supported (Under the Hammer Heist (Update 248) is the latest vanilla heist). Custom heists are not supported due to I have to look into the map scripts and find elements that can be tracked. However, support for them may come at later date.

data.name: United Offensive Plus: Enhanced Factions
data.desc:
United Offensive Plus: Enhanced Factions is an expanded continuation of United Offensive Plus, introducing additional enemy types, expanded faction rosters, and customizable enemy spawning.

Originally focused on fixing spawning issues and improving compatibility, this enhanced version goes further by introducing more enemy variants and allowing players to customize which enemies appear during assaults.

The goal is to make every faction feel more diverse, challenging, and enjoyable to fight against.

Main Features
1. Expanded Faction Rosters
Additional enemy types are introduced across five factions:
* America
* Russia
* Zombie
* Murkywater
* Federales

2. Additional Enemy Types
* Regular Police Officers
* Hostage Rescue Teams (HRT)
* Sniper Teams
* ZEAL Heavy Snipers
* Phalanx / Winters Shields
* Swat
* FBI
* Gensec
* ZEAL (NOT recommmand to use in multiplayer unless client also have this mod)
* Marshal Marksmen
* Marshal Shields
* Bulldozer Variants
* Halloween Headless Bulldozers
* Pre-U183 Medic Bulldozer (NOT recommmand to use in multiplayer unless client also have this mod)

3. Customizable Spawn Difficulty
Players can configure the minimum difficulty at which different enemy types become available.

Available difficulty settings:
* Never Spawn
* Normal
* Hard
* Very Hard
* Overkill
* Mayhem
* Death Wish
* Death Sentence

The selected difficulty also applies to higher difficulties.

4. Expanded Faction Compatibility
Not every faction has its own dedicated model for every enemy type.
Where faction-specific models are unavailable, compatible vanilla PAYDAY 2 enemy models are reused to expand the available rosters.

5. Performance and Stability Improvements
Includes improvements to enemy spawning logic and compatibility, with testing focused on the 64-bit version of PAYDAY 2.

Important Notes
* Some enemy variants are faction-specific, while others reuse vanilla models.
* Certain standard SWAT, FBI, GENSEC, and ZEAL variants are currently America-only.
* The Pre-U183 Medic Bulldozer has an additional multiplayer asset requirement. See the compatibility instructions.
* Mods that modify the same GroupAI spawning systems may have compatibility conflicts.

Installation
The download includes both United Offensive Plus Enhanced and Tmod Base.
Extract both folders into your PAYDAY 2 mods directory. Keep them as separate folders.

Credits
This project builds upon the work of the original United Offensive contributors:
* TK7 
* Schrodinger_Sig
* GTTOP

Link to their original mod:
https://modworkshop.net/mod/23628
https://modworkshop.net/mod/39769

Enhanced, modified, and maintained by BlueRyzen.

Thank you to the original creators and the PAYDAY 2 modding community.

data.name: Floating Healthbars
data.desc:
Adds customizable healthbars that are displayed above enemies when you aim at them.
You can customize the style of the healthbar, the direction it fills in, the size (including dynamic scaling based on text or enemy HP) and more in the mod options.

##### Presets
You can save and load presets through the menu. Presets will be saved in the `mods/saves/floating_healthbars/` folder and are basically just separate, named settings files that allow you to quickly apply a bunch of settings at once.

##### Creating your own designs
You can use the included `template.png` file to make your own healthbar design to use with the mod. The middle part of the image is what's used as the healthbar and will be stretched to the needed size. Top, middle and bottom row are background, healthbar and foreground respectively. The left and right sides are added to the left and right side of the healthbar. The space in between the squares is safe space to guarantee the UV mapping does not blur edges, make sure to horizontally extend your healthbar design a few pixels outside of the squares if you dont want blurry borders.

Once you're done, export the image as dds file and place it in `mods/saves/floating_healthbars/` to make the mod find it. Avoid placing it in the `assets` folder of the mod as you will lose any files you add there when the mod receives an update.

##### Credits
Chinese localization by [act2498](https://www.modworkshop.net/user/126452)
Korean localization by [8bit_sein](https://modworkshop.net/user/80256)
Spanish localization by [_atom](https://modworkshop.net/user/56033)

data.name: Big Lobby & Restoration Mod (Dev) Fix (14 Nov 2026 Update)
data.desc:
---

## **Big Lobby & Restoration Mod Compatibility Fix**

**Hello heisters!**

As you might know, trying to run **Big Lobby** and **Restoration Mod** together in PayDay 2 has stopped working. The game would consistently crash the exact moment an assault phase started, throwing the infamous `coretable.lua:803: bad argument #1 to 'maxn'` C++ exception.

Well, not anymore! My friends and I managed to track down the conflict and fix the issue. With this patch, you can finally enjoy both mods together without the game crashing during assaults.

---

### **CRASH LOG FIXED BY THIS MOD:**

```text
Application has crashed: C++ exception
[string "core/lib/utils/coretable.lua"]:803: bad argument #1 to 'maxn' (table expected, got nil)

SCRIPT STACK
unpack() core/lib/utils/coretable.lua:803
_find_spawn_group_near_area() lib/managers/group_ai_states/groupaistatebesiege.lua:1285
_upd_reenforce_tasks() lib/managers/group_ai_states/groupaistatebesiege.lua:1773
clbk() @mods/restoration-mod-dev/lua/sc/managers/groupaistatebesiege.lua:1352
...

```

---

### **Requirements & Compatibility Notes**

To ensure this fix works perfectly, make sure you are using the specific versions of the mods we used for testing:

* **Restoration Mod (Developer Version):** This fix was built and tested using the actively updated dev branch.
* [Download Restoration Mod Dev here](https://www.google.com/search?q=https://github.com/payday-restoration/restoration-mod/tree/dev)


* **Big Lobby:** The standard version available on ModWorkshop.
* [Download Big Lobby here](https://modworkshop.net/mod/21582)



---

### **Installation**

1. Make sure you have both **Big Lobby** and **Restoration Mod (Dev)** installed correctly.
2. Download this fix.
3. Drop the 2 files named 'groupaistatebase.lua' and 'groupaistatebesiege.lua' in this directory: PAYDAY 2\mods\restoration-mod-dev\lua\sc\managers
4. Drop the file name 'Corepre.lua' in this directory: \PAYDAY 2\mods\restoration-mod-dev
5. After the Diesel 3.0 Engine update I've inserted also another file named 'elementareatrigger.lua' that you have drop and overwrite in this directory: \PAYDAY 2\mods\restoration-mod-dev\lua\sc\managers\mission\

Please note that none of us were payday modders before this and if you find any bug or error let us know (and remember that the big lobby mod is discontinued and very unstable)

FOR ANY ISSUE PLEASE DM ON DISCORD MY USER IS: h_er_o

*Credits to my crew for helping me test and map out this fix. Keep those helmets flying, and enjoy playing with big lobbies and restoration features simultaneously!*

Extract The Executioner folder into PAYDAY 2/assets/mod_overrides.
For the 64-bit version of PAYDAY 2. LAS is not required.

data.name: Wolf's Flashbang Screams
data.desc:
**THANK YOU FOR 100 DOWNLOADS! <3**

This is my first mod, so I figured I would make something simple, yet incredibly needed, since as a Wolf main, I never hear him scream when he's flashbanged or shield-flashed. So I fixed that for you all!

He uses various "AAAAH, I CAN'T SEE!" voicelines from PDTH that I never saw being used in PD2 for some reason, even though the .stream files are there. I could only find 3 lines as of now, but if anyone knows of more flashbang/blind screams that Wolf has in PDTH etc, please let me know and I'll add them! The more, the merrier.
Also, please let me know if the volume is too low or high, and I'll fix it accordingly!

Put this in your mod_overrides.
You need Beardlib and SuperBLT, obviously.

[Video Demo](https://youtu.be/BAB9feEskTA)

data.name: Cinderella NIKKE Battle Announcer
data.desc:
Once upon a time, there was a nikke who was supposed to match the strength of the Goddess squad by herself. Born as the second generation of the Grimms Model Nikkes (alongside Little Mermaid, Hansel, & Gretel), she proclaims that she's the most beautiful & fairest nikke out there. This is Cinderella's story. To say that she's obsessed with beauty would be putting it lightly. She requested for a full-body size mirror to be placed every few hundred meters within a safe space. However, her story took a dark turn as she was corrupted and nearly destroyed her squad mates. After some time, she eventually recovered albeit her eyes are now red. Once the squad came back and set off toward the lift (space), she tried to fight the queen alone. She was unsuccessful, and she plummeted back down to Earth. Grave recovered her body and eventually revived her. Today, she and her squad all made a vow to rewrite their story to get their happy ending. She has 52 voicelines she can say, each having an equal chance of being played. Some lines are taken from her Glass Princess costume. Those are indicated with a (G), respectively. Specifically,

-----
When an enemy is killed (10 sec cooldown):
"I will go with you."
"They are humanity's enemy, and so I shall defeat them." 
"Let us get off to a beautiful start." 
"Gaze upon me, my audience." 
"All sorted." 
"There are more?" 
"Pathetic." 
"Prince, now is the time." 
"Glass Slippers, full contact. Pour out." 
"Now is the time of true beauty." 
"I'm so beautiful today. I like it." 
"I feel as though my beauty has reached new heights." 
"If you wish it so, Prince, I shall gladly oblige." (G)
"Let us move forward with grace and poise." (G)
"An intruder has arrived." (G)
"I shall wrap this up quickly, before midnight." (G)
"There are far too many things that lack beauty." (G)
"Next." (G)
"Begone." (G)
"You're in the way." (G)
"Prince, I'm ready." (G)
"Shine brightly for my radiant self." (G)
"Let us all strive to be beautiful." (G)
"I feel so beautiful right now." (G)
"Amongst this lambent glass, I, too, gleam with brilliance. I am satisfied." (G)
"I have become more beautiful!" (G)

-----
When the player takes damage (15 sec cooldown):
"It is not becoming to rush. I will go slowly." 
"I will clean up neatly and beautifully." 
"Let me check the mirror for a moment." 
"There's some dirt on my face." 
"Even when I'm preparing, I'm gorgeous." 
"Ow!" 
"How annoying." 
"Urgh!" 
"I don't believe there are enough mirrors here." 
"I won't forgive anyone who disrupts the ball." (G)
"Just a moment... I'll clean my glass slippers." (G)
"Rest assured, beauty remains impervious." (G)
"Don't worry, Prince. I'll keep you safe." (G)
"Ow!" (G)
"Urgh." (G)
"Phew..." (G)

-----
When a heist ends in success:
"What a truly beautiful story this was. I am most pleased with it."
"Please try and maintain your current appearance, Prince. If your beauty fades, your audience will abandon you."
"You're becoming more beautiful by the day. Would you like to look in the mirror and see just how ravishing you've become?"
"Our story, as well as yours, is bound to be beautiful."
"How do I look now, Prince? Am I beautiful?" (G)
"With you by my side, I'm shining brighter than ever." (G)
"I shall become even more beautiful. With my glass slippers on, I will strive forward." (G)
"I feel like I've been enchanted by a spell... I can't stop thinking about you." (G)

-----
When a heist ends in failure:
"This is not a beautiful story..."
"No... I can't end the story like this..." (G)

-----
In game demo: ![](https://youtu.be/t3yCApIYFIg)

Fail line (short): ![](https://youtu.be/wV4IQuLFUTE)

data.name: Infinite Spree Modifiers
data.desc:
# Finally, Infinite Crime Spree

**Requires [Randomize Crime Spree Modifiers](https://modworkshop.net/mod/50906).**

This mods adds new, infinitely repeatable modifiers into the pool, making the crime spree even more unbearably annoying to actually play.

!!!Full list of modifiers and changes.
---

**Existing modifiers repeated:**
- Medic's heal cooldown is {#007bff}(5%) faster.
- The tasing knockout effect of the Taser now knocks a player out {#007bff}(10%) faster.
- {#007bff}(One) additional Medic is allowed into the level.
- When a Bulldozer's faceplate is destroyed, the Bulldozer enters a berserker rage, receiving a {#007bff}(10%) increase to their base damage output.
- {#007bff}(One) additional Bulldozer is allowed into the level.
- Whenever a Medic revives another cop, the revived cop gets a {#007bff}(5%) increase to their base damage output.
- For every cop that dies within a Medic's healing range, that Medic sees his base damage output increased by {#007bff}(10%).
- The Minimum concealment level is increased by {#007bff}(1) in stealth.

All of these have their non-repeatable versions as prerequisites

---

**Entirely new modifiers:**
- Killing civilians activates their pagers.
Available after picking "*The alarm will be sounded if more than 4 civilians are killed*".
- {#007bff}(One) additional tazer is allowed to spawn.
!!!
